title: HOW I BOUGHT THE SCHOOL VENDING MACHINES 🍫

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Nix, why is there a literal mountain of gold-wrapped chocolate bars blocking my entire driveway and my luxury car right now?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That is not just chocolate, Uncle Jamal; [beat] that is the final shipment for the snack empire I built while you were all sleeping!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I knew those midnight scooter rides were suspicious, [beat] but I actually thought he was just stealing the neighbors' food deliveries!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: He actually used my secret spicy ramen recipe and turned it into a subscription service [beat] that literally every kid in the city signed up for!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I tried to bully him for his lunch money last month, [beat] but now I am actually on his payroll as the head of regional snack distribution!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: The school board was wondering why the cafeteria was empty, [beat] until we realized Nix bought the exclusive rights to every machine on campus!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It turns out that when you combine a fast scooter with a hungry neighborhood, [beat] you do not just get crumbs, you get a total monopoly!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I am proud of you, Nix, [beat] but we really need to discuss how you managed to launder three thousand dollars through your sister's lemonade stand!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Wait a minute, [beat] if Nix is the CEO, then why is our family garage filled with three tons of imported salt-and-vinegar chips right now?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Because he did not just build a business, [beat] he signed a deal to become the official supplier for the entire city's gaming tournament next week!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: They laughed at me for riding a scooter at 3 AM, [beat] but now I am the one signing the checks for everyone's brand new iPhones!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Nix, does this mean you can finally afford to take me on that fancy dinner date [beat] instead of just sharing a single bag of pretzels?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix turned a midnight craving into a commercial kingdom, proving that sometimes, [beat] the smallest crumbs lead to the biggest fortunes.
